Bleed.name: Bleed
Bleed.effect: Inflicts {[bleed_amt]} stacks of bleed. Bleeding enemies receive 1 damage per stack when hit by a ball (Max {[bleed_max_stacks]} stacks)
Bleed.effectCn: 施加{[bleed_amt]}层流血。每层流血将使敌人在受到弹珠攻击时额外承受1点伤害（最高{[bleed_max_stacks]}层）

Brood Mother.name: Brood Mother
Brood Mother.effect: Has a {[birth_chance]} chance of birthing a baby ball each time it hits an enemy
Brood Mother.effectCn: 每次命中敌人时有{[birth_chance]}几率创造1颗迷你弹珠

Burn.name: Burn
Burn.effect: Add 1 stack of burn on hit for {[burn_length]} seconds (max {[max_burn_stacks]} stacks). Burnt units are dealt {[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]} damage per stack per second.
Burn.effectCn: 命中时施加1层燃烧，效果持续{[burn_length]}秒（最高{[max_burn_stacks]}层）。每层燃烧每秒造成{[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]}伤害。

Cell.name: Cell
Cell.effect: Splits into a clone on hit {[cell_limit]} times.
Cell.effectCn: 被击中{[cell_limit]}次后分裂出1颗相同的弹珠。

Charm.name: Charm
Charm.effect: Each hit has a {[charm_chance]} chance of charming the enemy for {[charm_length]} seconds. Charmed units walk up the board and attack enemies.
Charm.effectCn: 每次命中时有{[charm_chance]}几率魅惑敌人，效果持续{[charm_length]}秒。被魅惑的单位将会转而向上方移动并攻击其他敌人。

Dark.name: Dark
Dark.effect: Deals {[damage_multiplier]}x damage but destroys itself after hitting an enemy. Has a {[cooldown_length]} second cooldown before it can be shot again.
Dark.effectCn: 造成{[damage_multiplier]}x伤害，但是在命中敌人后将自毁。每次发射后需要等待{[cooldown_length]}秒冷却时间。

Earthquake.name: Earthquake
Earthquake.effect: Deals {[min_earthquake_damage]}-{[max_earthquake_damage]} damage to nearby units in a {[range]}x{[range]} tile square
Earthquake.effectCn: 对{[range]}x{[range]}格范围内的单位造成{[min_earthquake_damage]}-{[max_earthquake_damage]}伤害

Egg Sac.name: Egg Sac
Egg Sac.effect: Explodes into {[min_babies]}-{[max_babies]} baby balls on hitting an enemy. Has a {[cooldown_length]} second cooldown before it can be shot again.
Egg Sac.effectCn: 命中敌人时分裂出{[min_babies]}-{[max_babies]}颗迷你弹珠。每次发射后需要等待{[cooldown_length]}秒冷却时间。

Freeze.name: Freeze
Freeze.effect: Has a {[freeze_pct]} chance to freeze enemies for {[freeze_length]} seconds. Frozen enemies receive {[freeze_damage_pct]} more damage
Freeze.effectCn: 有{[freeze_pct]}几率冰冻敌人，效果持续{[freeze_length]}秒。被冰冻的敌人将额外承受{[freeze_damage_pct]}伤害

Iron.name: Iron
Iron.effect: Deals double damage but moves {[reduce_speed_pct]} slower
Iron.effectCn: 造成双倍伤害，但是移动速度减慢{[reduce_speed_pct]}

Laser (Horizontal).name: Laser (Horizontal)
Laser (Horizontal).effect: Deals {[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]} damage to all enemies in the same row
Laser (Horizontal).effectCn: 对同一行的所有敌人造成{[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]}伤害。

Laser (Vertical).name: Laser (Vertical)
Laser (Vertical).effect: Deals {[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]} damage to all enemies in the same column
Laser (Vertical).effectCn: 对同一列的所有敌人造成{[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]}伤害。

Light.name: Light
Light.effect: Blinds enemies on hit for {[blind_length]} seconds. Blinded units have a hard time detecting you and have a 50% chance of missing when they attack.
Light.effectCn: 命中时使敌人致盲，效果持续{[blind_length]}秒。致盲的敌人将难以察觉到你的存在，并且攻击时有50%几率失手。

Lightning.name: Lightning
Lightning.effect: Deals {[min_lightning_damage]}-{[max_lightning_damage]} damage to up to {[lightning_limit]} nearby enemies
Lightning.effectCn: 对附近至多{[lightning_limit]}名敌人造成{[min_lightning_damage]}-{[max_lightning_damage]}伤害

Poison.name: Poison
Poison.effect: Applies 1 stack of poison on hit (max {[max_poison_stacks]} stacks). Poison lasts for {[poison_length]} seconds and each stack deals {[min_poison_damage]}-{[max_poison_damage]} damage per second
Poison.effectCn: 命中时施加1层中毒（最高{[max_poison_stacks]}层）。中毒持续{[poison_length]}秒，每层中毒每秒造成{[min_poison_damage]}-{[max_poison_damage]}伤害。

Vampire.name: Vampire
Vampire.effect: Each hit has a {[lifesteal_chance]} chance of healing {[lifesteal_heal]} health
Vampire.effectCn: 每次命中时有{[lifesteal_chance]}几率恢复{[lifesteal_heal]}点生命值

Wind.name: Wind
Wind.effect: Passes through enemies and slows them down by {[slow_pct]} for {[slow_len]} seconds, but deals 25% less damage.
Wind.effectCn: 仅造成75%伤害，但是能够穿过敌人并使其减速{[slow_pct]}，效果持续{[slow_len]}秒。

Stone.name: Stone
Stone.effect: Initially deals {[damage_pct]} damage. Damage erodes by {[reduce_dmg_pct]} each time hitting an enemy (minimum {[min_damage_pct]}).
Stone.effectCn: 最初造成{[damage_pct]}伤害。每次命中敌人时伤害降低{[reduce_dmg_pct]}（最低{[min_damage_pct]}）。

Time.name: Time
Time.effect: Explodes into a time snare upon hitting an enemy, which stays on the field for {[time_snare_length]} seconds and freezes enemies inside it.
Time.effectCn: 命中敌人时爆炸并展开一片时间陷阱，陷阱将在场上停留{[time_snare_length]}秒，并且冻结范围内的所有敌人。

Leech.name: Leech
Leech.effect: Attaches up to 1 leech onto enemies it hits, which adds {[bleed_amt]} stacks of bleed per second (Max {[bleed_max_stacks]} stacks)
Leech.effectCn: 命中时对敌人施加至多1层吸血水蛭，吸血水蛭每秒施加{[bleed_amt]}层流血（最高{[bleed_max_stacks]}层流血）

Berserk.name: Berserk
Berserk.effect: Each hit has a {[berserk_chance]} chance of causing enemies to go berserk for {[berserk_length]} seconds. Berserk enemies deal {[min_berserk_damage]}-{[max_berserk_damage]} damage to adjacent enemies every second.
Berserk.effectCn: 每次命中有{[berserk_chance]}几率使敌人狂暴，效果持续{[berserk_length]}秒。狂暴的敌人将对毗邻的其他敌人造成每秒{[min_berserk_damage]}-{[max_berserk_damage]}伤害。

Sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
Sacrifice.effect: Inflicts {[bleed_amt]} stacks of bleed (Max {[bleed_max_stacks]} stacks) and applies curse to hit enemies. Cursed enemies are dealt {[min_curse_damage]}-{[max_curse_damage]} after being hit {[curse_delay]} times.
Sacrifice.effectCn: 命中时施加{[bleed_amt]}层流血（最高{[bleed_max_stacks]}层）以及诅咒。被诅咒的敌人在受到{[curse_delay]}次攻击后将承受{[min_curse_damage]}-{[max_curse_damage]}伤害。

Hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
Hemorrhage.effect: Inflicts {[bleed_amt]} stacks of bleed. When hitting an enemy with {[bleed_max_stacks]} stacks of bleed or more, consumes all stacks of bleed to deal {[hemorrhage_pct]} of their current health.
Hemorrhage.effectCn: 施加{[bleed_amt]}层流血。如果敌人身上的流血效果有{[bleed_max_stacks]}层或以上，击中敌人时将消耗所有流血层数，并造成等同于敌人最大生命值{[hemorrhage_pct]}的伤害。

Vampire Lord.name: Vampire Lord
Vampire Lord.effect: Each hit inflicts {[bleed_amt]} stacks of bleed. Heals {[lifesteal_heal]} health and consumes all stacks when hitting an enemy with at least {[lifesteal_bleed_stacks]} stacks of bleed.
Vampire Lord.effectCn: 每次命中时施加{[bleed_amt]}层流血。如果敌人身上有{[lifesteal_bleed_stacks]}层流血效果或以上，击中敌人时将消耗所有流血层数，并为你恢复{[lifesteal_heal]}点生命值。

Maggot.name: Maggot
Maggot.effect: Infest enemies on hit with maggots. When they die, they explode into {[min_babies]}-{[max_babies]} baby balls
Maggot.effectCn: 命中时将使敌人被蛆虫缠身。这些敌人死亡时将会分裂出{[min_babies]}-{[max_babies]}颗迷你弹珠

Spider Queen.name: Spider Queen
Spider Queen.effect: Has a {[birth_chance]} chance of birthing an Egg Sac each time it hits an enemy
Spider Queen.effectCn: 每次命中敌人时有{[birth_chance]}几率创造1颗巢囊

Mosquito King.name: Mosquito King
Mosquito King.effect: Spawns a mosquito each time it hits an enemy. Mosquitos attack a random enemy, dealing {[min_mosquito_damage]} - {[max_mosquito_damage]} damage each. If a mosquito kills an enemy, they steal {[lifesteal_heal]} health.
Mosquito King.effectCn: 每次命中敌人时生成1只蚊子。蚊子将会对随机敌人发起攻击，并造成{[min_mosquito_damage]}-{[max_mosquito_damage]}伤害。如果蚊子成功杀死敌人，它们将能够为你窃取{[lifesteal_heal]}点生命值。

Magma.name: Magma
Magma.effect: Emits lava blobs over time. Enemies who walk into lava blobs are dealt {[min_magma_damage]} - {[max_magma_damage]} damage and gain 1 stack of burn (max {[max_burn_stacks]} stacks). Burn lasts for {[burn_length]} seconds, dealing  {[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]} damage per stack per second.  This ball and its lava blobs also deal {[min_earthquake_damage]}-{[max_earthquake_damage]} damage to nearby units.
Magma.effectCn: 持续释放岩浆池。经过岩浆池的敌人将承受{[min_magma_damage]}-{[max_magma_damage]}伤害以及1层燃烧（最高{[max_burn_stacks]}层）。燃烧持续{[burn_length]}秒，每层燃烧每秒造成{[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]}伤害。除此以外，此弹珠与释放的岩浆池在命中时还会对周遭敌人造成{[min_earthquake_damage]}-{[max_earthquake_damage]}伤害。

Frozen Flame.name: Frozen Flame
Frozen Flame.effect: Add 1 stack of frostburn on hit for {[frostburn_length]} seconds (max {[max_frostburn_stacks]} stacks). Frostburnt units are dealt {[min_frostburn_damage]}-{[max_frostburn_damage]} damage per stack per second and receive {[freeze_damage_pct]} more damage from other sources.
Frozen Flame.effectCn: 命中时施加1层霜燃，效果持续{[frostburn_length]}秒（最高{[max_frostburn_stacks]}层）。每层霜燃每秒造成{[min_frostburn_damage]}-{[max_frostburn_damage]}伤害，并且使目标敌人承受的其他伤害提高{[freeze_damage_pct]}。

Bomb.name: Bomb
Bomb.effect: Explodes when hitting an enemy, dealing {[min_bomb_damage]}-{[max_bomb_damage]} damage to nearby enemies. Has a {[cooldown_length]} second cooldown before it can be shot again.
Bomb.effectCn: 命中敌人时爆炸，对周遭敌人造成{[min_bomb_damage]}-{[max_bomb_damage]}伤害。每次发射后需要等待{[cooldown_length]}秒冷却时间。

Sun.name: Sun
Sun.effect: Blind all enemies in view and add 1 stack of burn every second (max {[max_burn_stacks]} stacks). Burn lasts for {[burn_length]} seconds and deals {[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]} damage per stack per second.
Sun.effectCn: 使视野中的所有敌人致盲，并且每秒施加1层燃烧（最高{[max_burn_stacks]}层）。燃烧持续{[burn_length]}秒，每层燃烧每秒造成{[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]}伤害。

Inferno.name: Inferno
Inferno.effect: Applies 1 stack of burn every second to all enemies within a {[range]} tile radius. Burn lasts for {[burn_length]} seconds, dealing {[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]} damage per stack per second.
Inferno.effectCn: 每秒对{[range]}格范围内的敌人施加1层燃烧。燃烧效果持续{[burn_length]}秒，每层燃烧每秒造成{[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]}伤害。

Overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
Overgrowth.effect: Applies 1 stack of overgrowth. Upon reaching {[max_overgrowth_stacks]}, consume all stacks and deal {[min_overgrowth_damage]}-{[max_overgrowth_damage]} damage to all enemies in a {[range]}x{[range]} tile square.
Overgrowth.effectCn: 施加1层蔓延。堆叠{[max_overgrowth_stacks]}层后，消耗所有层数并对{[range]}x{[range]}格范围内的所有敌人造成{[min_overgrowth_damage]}-{[max_overgrowth_damage]}伤害。

Radiation Beam.name: Radiation Beam
Radiation Beam.effect: Emit a radiation beam on hit that deals {[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]} damage and applies 1 stack of radiation (max {[max_radiation_stacks]} stacks). Radiation lasts for {[radiation_length]} seconds and cause enemies to receive {[radiation_pct]} more damage from all sources per stack.
Radiation Beam.effectCn: 命中时释放一道辐射光束，造成{[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]}伤害并施加1层核辐射（最高{[max_radiation_stacks]}层）。核辐射持续{[radiation_length]}秒，每层核辐射使敌人额外承受{[radiation_pct]}的所有来源伤害。

Virus.name: Virus
Virus.effect: Applies 1 stack of disease to units it hits (max {[max_disease_stacks]} stacks). Disease lasts for {[disease_length]} seconds. Each stack of disease deals {[min_disease_damage]}-{[max_disease_damage]} damage per second and diseased units have a {[disease_chance]} chance of passing a stack to undiseased nearby enemies each second.
Virus.effectCn: 命中时施加1层瘟疫（最高{[max_disease_stacks]}层）。瘟疫持续{[disease_length]}秒。每层瘟疫每秒造成{[min_disease_damage]}-{[max_disease_damage]}伤害，除此以外，承受瘟疫的敌人每秒有{[disease_chance]}%几率向周遭的健康敌人传染1层瘟疫。

Incubus.name: Incubus
Incubus.effect: Each hit has a {[charm_chance]} chance of charming the enemy for {[charm_length]} seconds. Charmed enemies curse nearby enemies. Cursed enemies are dealt {[min_curse_damage]}-{[max_curse_damage]} after being hit {[curse_delay]} times.
Incubus.effectCn: 每次命中时有{[charm_chance]}几率魅惑敌人，效果持续{[charm_length]}秒。被魅惑的敌人将诅咒周遭的敌人。被诅咒的敌人在受到{[curse_delay]}次攻击后将承受{[min_curse_damage]}-{[max_curse_damage]}伤害。

Lovestruck.name: Lovestruck
Lovestruck.effect: Inflicts lovestruck on hit enemies for {[lovestruck_length]} seconds. Lovestruck units have a 50% chance of healing you for {[lovestruck_heal]} health when they attack.
Lovestruck.effectCn: 对命中的敌人施加热恋，效果持续{[lovestruck_length]}秒。陷入热恋的单位在发起攻击时将有50%几率转而为你恢复{[lovestruck_heal]}点生命值。

Succubus.name: Succubus
Succubus.effect: Each hit has a {[charm_chance]} chance of charming the enemy for {[charm_length]} seconds. Heals {[lifesteal_heal]} when hitting a charmed enemy.
Succubus.effectCn: 每次命中时有{[charm_chance]}几率魅惑敌人，效果持续{[charm_length]}秒。命中被魅惑的敌人时恢复{[lifesteal_heal]}点生命值。

Phantom.name: Phantom
Phantom.effect: Curse enemies on hit. Cursed enemies are dealt {[min_curse_damage]}-{[max_curse_damage]} damage after being hit {[curse_delay]} times.
Phantom.effectCn: 命中时施加诅咒。被诅咒的敌人在受到{[curse_delay]}次攻击后将承受{[min_curse_damage]}-{[max_curse_damage]}伤害。

Assassin.name: Assassin
Assassin.effect: Passes through the front of enemies, but not the back. Backstabs deal {[damage_pct]} bonus damage.
Assassin.effectCn: 从正面穿过敌人，但是不会穿过敌人的后背。背刺造成{[damage_pct]}额外伤害。

Flicker.name: Flicker
Flicker.effect: Deals {[min_flicker_damage]}-{[max_flicker_damage]} damage to every enemy on screen every {[flicker_cycle]} seconds.
Flicker.effectCn: 每隔{[flicker_cycle]}秒对场上的所有敌人造成{[min_flicker_damage]}-{[max_flicker_damage]}伤害。

Noxious.name: Noxious
Noxious.effect: Passes through enemies and applies {[max_poison_stacks]} stacks of poison to nearby enemies within a {[range]} tile radius. Poison lasts for {[poison_length]} seconds and each stack deals {[min_poison_damage]}-{[max_poison_damage]} damage per second.
Noxious.effectCn: 穿过敌人，并且对其周遭{[max_poison_stacks]}格范围内的所有敌人施加{[range]}层中毒。中毒持续{[poison_length]}秒，每层中毒每秒造成{[min_poison_damage]}-{[max_poison_damage]}伤害。

Glacier.name: Glacier
Glacier.effect: Releases glacial spikes over time that deal {[min_glacier_damage]}-{[max_glacier_damage]} to enemies that touch them and freeze them for {[freeze_length]} seconds. This ball and its glacial spikes also deal {[min_earthquake_damage]}-{[max_earthquake_damage]} damage to nearby units.
Glacier.effectCn: 持续释放冰刺，对触碰冰刺的敌人造成{[min_glacier_damage]}-{[max_glacier_damage]}伤害，并且施加冰冻，持续{[freeze_length]}秒。除此以外，此弹珠与释放的冰刺在命中时还会对周遭敌人造成{[min_earthquake_damage]}-{[max_earthquake_damage]}伤害。

Swamp.name: Swamp
Swamp.effect: Leaves behind tar blobs over time. Enemies who walk into tar blobs are dealt {[min_tar_damage]} - {[max_tar_damage]}, are slowed by {[slow_pct]} for {[slow_len]} seconds and gain 1 stack of poison (max {[max_poison_stacks]} stacks). Each stack of poison deals  {[min_poison_damage]}-{[max_poison_damage]} damage per second.  This ball and its tar blobs also deal {[min_earthquake_damage]}-{[max_earthquake_damage]} damage to nearby units.
Swamp.effectCn: 持续释放焦油池。焦油池将对经过的敌人造成{[min_tar_damage]}-{[max_tar_damage]}伤害，持续{[slow_len]}秒的{[slow_pct]}减速，以及1层中毒（最高{[max_poison_stacks]}层）每层中毒每秒造成{[min_poison_damage]}-{[max_poison_damage]}伤害。除此以外，此弹珠与释放的焦油池在命中时还会对周遭敌人造成{[min_earthquake_damage]}-{[max_earthquake_damage]}伤害。

Sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
Sandstorm.effect: Goes through enemies and is surrounded by a raging storm dealing {[min_sandstorm_damage]}-{[max_sandstorm_damage]} damage per second and blinding nearby enemies for {[blind_length]} seconds.
Sandstorm.effectCn: 穿过敌人，此弹珠受到沙暴笼罩，每秒造成{[min_sandstorm_damage]}-{[max_sandstorm_damage]}伤害并使敌人致盲，效果持续{[blind_length]}秒。

Shotgun.name: Shotgun
Shotgun.effect: Shoots {[min_babies]}-{[max_babies]} iron baby balls after hitting a wall. Iron baby balls move at {[base_speed]} speed but are destroyed upon hitting anything.
Shotgun.effectCn: 每次命中墙壁时发射{[min_babies]}-{[max_babies]}颗迷你黑铁弹珠。迷你黑铁弹珠的移动速度高达{[base_speed]}，但是命中任意敌人后将自毁。

Wraith.name: Wraith
Wraith.effect: Freezes any enemy it passes through for {[freeze_length]} seconds
Wraith.effectCn: 冰冻经过的敌人，效果持续{[freeze_length]}秒

Freeze Ray.name: Freeze Ray
Freeze Ray.effect: Emits a freeze ray when hitting an enemy, dealing  {[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]} to all enemies in its path, with a {[freeze_pct]} chance of freezing them for {[freeze_length]} seconds
Freeze Ray.effectCn: 命中敌人时发射一道冰冻射线，射线将对路径上的所有敌人造成{[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]}伤害，并且有{[freeze_pct]}几率冰冻敌人，效果持续{[freeze_length]}秒

Blizzard.name: Blizzard
Blizzard.effect: Freezes all enemies within a {[range]} tile radius for {[freeze_length]} seconds, dealing {[min_lightning_damage]}-{[max_lightning_damage]} damage.
Blizzard.effectCn: 冰冻{[range]}格范围内的所有敌人并造成{[min_lightning_damage]}-{[max_lightning_damage]}伤害，冰冻效果持续{[freeze_length]}秒。

Soul Sucker.name: Soul Sucker
Soul Sucker.effect: Passes through enemies and saps them, with a {[lifesteal_chance]} chance of stealing {[lifesteal_heal]} health and reducing their attack damage by {[reduce_dmg_pct]}. Lifesteal chance only applies once per enemy.
Soul Sucker.effectCn: 穿过敌人，有{[lifesteal_chance]}几率窃取{[lifesteal_heal]}生命值并且使敌人的攻击伤害降低{[reduce_dmg_pct]}。吸血几率只能对每名敌人作用1次。

Holy Laser.name: Holy Laser
Holy Laser.effect: Deals {[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]} damage to all enemies in the same row and column
Holy Laser.effectCn: 对同一行同一列的所有敌人造成{[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]}伤害。

Laser Beam.name: Laser Beam
Laser Beam.effect: Emit a laser beam on hit that deals {[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]} damage and blinds enemies for {[blind_length]} seconds.
Laser Beam.effectCn: 命中时发射一道激光束，造成{[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]}伤害并且使敌人致盲，效果持续{[blind_length]}秒。

Flash.name: Flash
Flash.effect: Damage all enemies on screen for {[min_flash_damage]} - {[max_flash_damage]} damage after hitting an enemy and blind them for {[blind_length]} seconds.
Flash.effectCn: 命中一名敌人后对场上的所有敌人造成{[min_flash_damage]}-{[max_flash_damage]}伤害，并使其致盲，效果持续{[blind_length]}秒。

Lightning Rod.name: Lightning Rod
Lightning Rod.effect: Plants a lightning rod into enemies it hits. These enemies are struck by lightning every {[lightning_rod_length]} seconds, dealing {[min_lightning_damage]}-{[max_lightning_damage]} damage to up to {[lightning_limit]} nearby enemies
Lightning Rod.effectCn: 命中时在敌人身上放置1个避雷针。被插上避雷针的敌人将每隔{[lightning_rod_length]}秒被闪电击中，并且对其周遭至多{[lightning_limit]}名敌人造成{[min_lightning_damage]}-{[max_lightning_damage]}伤害

Storm.name: Storm
Storm.effect: Emits lightning to strike nearby enemies every second, dealing {[min_lightning_damage]}-{[max_lightning_damage]} damage.
Storm.effectCn: 释放闪电打击周围的敌人，每秒造成{[min_lightning_damage]}-{[max_lightning_damage]}伤害。

Mosquito Swarm.name: Mosquito Swarm
Mosquito Swarm.effect: Explodes into {[min_mosquitos]}-{[max_mosquitos]} mosquitos. Mosquitos attack random enemies, dealing {[min_mosquito_damage]} - {[max_mosquito_damage]} damage each. If a mosquito kills an enemy, they steal {[lifesteal_heal]} health.
Mosquito Swarm.effectCn: 分裂出{[min_mosquitos]}-{[max_mosquitos]}只蚊子。蚊子将会对随机敌人发起攻击，并造成{[min_mosquito_damage]}-{[max_mosquito_damage]}伤害。如果蚊子成功杀死敌人，它们将能够为你窃取{[lifesteal_heal]}点生命值。

Voluptuous Egg Sac.name: Voluptuous Egg Sac
Voluptuous Egg Sac.effect: Explodes into {[min_egg_sacs]}-{[max_egg_sacs]} egg sacs on hitting an enemy. Has a {[cooldown_length]} second cooldown before it can be shot again.
Voluptuous Egg Sac.effectCn: 命中敌人时分裂出{[min_egg_sacs]}-{[max_egg_sacs]}颗巢囊每次发射后需要等待{[cooldown_length]}秒冷却时间。

Steel.name: Steel
Steel.effect: Initially deals double damage but moves {[reduce_speed_pct]} slower. Damage increases by {[damage_pct]} each time it hits an enemy (max {[max_damage_pct]}).
Steel.effectCn: 最初造成双倍伤害，但是移动速度减慢{[reduce_speed_pct]}。每次命中敌人时伤害提高{[damage_pct]}（最高{[max_damage_pct]}）。

Catapult.name: Catapult
Catapult.effect: Launches {[min_babies]}-{[max_babies]} stone baby balls every {[spawn_rate]} seconds, which are destroyed after hitting anything.
Catapult.effectCn: 每隔{[spawn_rate]}秒发射{[min_babies]}-{[max_babies]}迷你岩石弹珠，岩石弹珠在命中任意敌人后将自毁。

Landslide.name: Landslide
Landslide.effect: Creates a landslide and destroys self upon hitting an enemy. The landslide lasts for {[landslide_len]} seconds and deals {[min_landslide_damage]}-{[max_landslide_damage]} damage / second to enemies within a {[range]} tile radius.
Landslide.effectCn: 命中敌人时自爆并创造一片地裂区域。地裂区域将持续{[landslide_len]}秒，并且每秒对{[range]}格范围内的敌人造成{[min_landslide_damage]}-{[max_landslide_damage]}伤害。

Brimstone.name: Brimstone
Brimstone.effect: Applies 1 stack of burn and poison every second to all enemies within a {[range]} tile radius (max {[max_burn_stacks]} stacks). Burn deals {[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]} damage per stack per second and poison deals {[min_poison_damage]}-{[max_poison_damage]} damage per stack per second.
Brimstone.effectCn: 每秒对{[range]}格范围内的敌人施加1层燃烧与中毒（最高{[max_burn_stacks]}层）。每层燃烧每秒造成{[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]}伤害，每层中毒每秒造成{[min_poison_damage]}-{[max_poison_damage]}伤害。

Petrify.name: Petrify
Petrify.effect: Petrifies all enemies within its sightline for {[petrify_len]} seconds when first launched, dealing {[min_petrify_damage]}-{[max_petrify_damage]}.
Petrify.effectCn: 使发射时位于弹珠视野范围内的所有敌人石化并造成{[min_petrify_damage]}-{[max_petrify_damage]}伤害，效果持续{[petrify_len]}秒。

Fireworks.name: Fireworks
Fireworks.effect: Explodes into {[min_fireworks]}-{[max_fireworks]} fireworks. Fireworks target random enemies, dealing {[min_firework_damage]} - {[max_firework_damage]} damage and applying 1 stack of burn. Burnt units are dealt {[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]} damage per stack per second.
Fireworks.effectCn: 命中敌人时分裂出{[min_fireworks]}-{[max_fireworks]}颗烟花。分裂出的烟花将追踪随机敌人，造成{[min_firework_damage]}-{[max_firework_damage]}伤害并施加1层燃烧。每层燃烧每秒造成{[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]}伤害。

Venom.name: Venom
Venom.effect: Applies 1 stack of venom on hit (max {[max_venom_stacks]} stacks). Each stack deals {[min_venom_damage]}-{[max_venom_damage]} damage per second and slows down enemies.
Venom.effectCn: 命中时施加1层剧毒（最高{[max_venom_stacks]}层）。每层剧毒每秒造成{[min_venom_damage]}-{[max_venom_damage]}伤害，并且使敌人减速。

Heart Swallower.name: Heart Swallower
Heart Swallower.effect: Saps enemies on hit, with a {[lifesteal_chance]} chance of stealing {[lifesteal_heal]} health and reducing their attack damage by {[reduce_dmg_pct]}. Lifesteal chance only applies once per enemy.
Heart Swallower.effectCn: 命中敌人时，有{[lifesteal_chance]}几率窃取{[lifesteal_heal]}点生命值，并使敌人的攻击伤害降低{[reduce_dmg_pct]}。吸血几率只能对每名敌人作用1次。

Banished Flame.name: Banished Flame
Banished Flame.effect: Add 1 stack of darkflame on hit for {[burn_length]} seconds (max {[max_burn_stacks]} stacks). Darkflame deals {[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]} damage per stack per second. When the darkflame goes out, it deals {[min_darkflame_burst]}-{[max_darkflame_burst]} to the enemy.
Banished Flame.effectCn: 命中时施加1层暗焰，效果持续{[burn_length]}秒（最高{[max_burn_stacks]}层）。每层暗焰每秒造成{[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]}伤害。暗焰熄灭时将对敌人造成{[min_darkflame_burst]}-{[max_darkflame_burst]}伤害。

Timestop.name: Timestop
Timestop.effect: Freezes everything on the field for {[time_snare_length]} seconds but destroys itself after hitting an enemy. Has a {[cooldown_length]} second cooldown before it can be shot again.
Timestop.effectCn: 使场上的所有目标冻结{[time_snare_length]}秒，但是弹珠将在命中敌人后自毁。每次发射后需要等待{[cooldown_length]}秒冷却时间。

Warp.name: Warp
Warp.effect: After each hit, warps to a random spot on the field and speeds up by {[base_speed]}
Warp.effectCn: 每次命中敌人后，弹珠将跃迁至场上的随机位置并获得{[base_speed]}速度提升。

Erosion.name: Erosion
Erosion.effect: Passes through enemies. Deals {[damage_pct]} of enemy's current health as bonus damage on hit.
Erosion.effectCn: 穿过敌人。命中时造成等同于敌人当前生命值的{[damage_pct]}的额外伤害。

Offspring.name: Offspring
Offspring.effect: Splits into a clone on hit {[cell_limit]} times.
Offspring.effectCn: 被击中{[cell_limit]}次后分裂出1颗相同的弹珠。

Flesh Mound.name: Flesh Mound
Flesh Mound.effect: Emits a fleshy baby ball in a random direction every {[spawn_rate]} seconds.
Flesh Mound.effectCn: 每隔{[spawn_rate]}秒朝随机方向发射一颗肉块迷你弹珠。

Zombie.name: Zombie
Zombie.effect: Infects enemies on hit, giving them a {[zombie_chance]} chance to turn into a friendly zombie on death
Zombie.effectCn: 命中时感染敌人，被感染的敌人在死亡时有{[zombie_chance]}几率转化为1个友方僵尸。

Nuclear Bomb.name: Nuclear Bomb
Nuclear Bomb.effect: Explodes when hitting an enemy, dealing {[min_bomb_damage]}-{[max_bomb_damage]} damage to nearby enemies and applying 1 stack of radiation to everyone present indefinitely (max {[max_radiation_stacks]} stacks). Each stack of radiation increases damage received by {[radiation_pct]}. Has a {[cooldown_length]} second cooldown.
Nuclear Bomb.effectCn: 命中敌人时爆炸，对周遭敌人造成{[min_bomb_damage]}-{[max_bomb_damage]}伤害，并且对场上所有人施加1层核辐射，核辐射效果将永久持续（最高{[max_radiation_stacks]}层）。每层核辐射使敌人额外承受{[radiation_pct]}伤害。发射后有{[cooldown_length]}秒冷却时间。

Black Hole.name: Black Hole
Black Hole.effect: Instantly kills the first non-boss enemy that it hits, but destroys itself afterwards. Has a {[cooldown_length]} second cooldown before it can be shot again.
Black Hole.effectCn: 立即击杀命中的第一个敌人（非Boss），但是之后将自毁。每次发射后需要等待{[cooldown_length]}秒冷却时间。

Satan.name: Satan
Satan.effect: While active, add 1 stack of burn to all active enemies per second (max {[max_burn_stacks]} stacks), dealing {[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]} damage per stack per second and make them go berserk, dealing {[min_berserk_damage]}-{[max_berserk_damage]} damage to adjacent enemies every second.
Satan.effectCn: 存在于场上时，每秒对所有敌人施加1层燃烧（最高{[max_burn_stacks]}层），每层燃烧每秒造成{[min_burn_damage]}-{[max_burn_damage]}伤害，除此以外使敌人狂暴，狂暴的敌人将对毗邻的其他敌人造成每秒{[min_berserk_damage]}-{[max_berserk_damage]}伤害。

Nosferatu.name: Nosferatu
Nosferatu.effect: Spawns a vampire bat each bounce. Vampire bats fly towards a random enemy, dealing {[min_vampire_bat_damage]}-{[max_vampire_bat_damage]} damage on hit, turning into a Vampire Lord.
Nosferatu.effectCn: 每次反弹时生成1只吸血蝙蝠。吸血蝙蝠将飞向一名随机敌人，命中时造成{[min_vampire_bat_damage]}-{[max_vampire_bat_damage]}伤害，之后蝙蝠将变成1颗吸血鬼领主。

Banshee.name: Banshee
Banshee.effect: Curses all enemies while on the field when launched. Cursed enemies are dealt {[min_curse_damage]}-{[max_curse_damage]} after being hit {[curse_delay]} times.
Banshee.effectCn: 发射后诅咒场上的所有敌人。被诅咒的敌人在受到{[curse_delay]}次攻击后将承受{[min_curse_damage]}-{[max_curse_damage]}伤害。

Reaper.name: Reaper
Reaper.effect: Has a {[kill_chance]} chance to kill enemies on impact, healing you for {[kill_heal]} health.
Reaper.effectCn: 撞击目标时有{[kill_chance]}几率立即杀死敌人，并为你恢复{[kill_heal]}生命值。

Sniper.name: Sniper
Sniper.effect: Pierces enemies and shoots {[min_babies]}-{[max_babies]} sniper baby balls after hitting a wall. Sniper baby balls pierce enemies but are destroyed upon hitting a wall.
Sniper.effectCn: 击中墙壁后穿透敌人并射出{[min_babies]}-{[max_babies]}枚狙击手迷你弹珠。狙击手迷你弹珠可以穿透敌人，但碰到墙壁后立即摧毁。

Time Bomb.name: Time Bomb
Time Bomb.effect: Throws a time bomb every few seconds, which explodes after a delay, dealing {[min_bomb_damage]}-{[max_bomb_damage]} damage to nearby enemies.
Time Bomb.effectCn: 每隔数秒投掷一枚时间炸弹，炸弹将在短暂延迟后引爆，对附近敌人造成{[min_bomb_damage]}-{[max_bomb_damage]}伤害。

Tumor.name: Tumor
Tumor.effect: Applies tumor on hit. Enemies with a tumor die after {[tumor_length]} seconds (except for bosses).
Tumor.effectCn: 命中时施加肿瘤。受肿瘤影响的敌人（除Boss以外）将在{[tumor_length]}秒后死亡。

X Ray.name: X Ray
X Ray.effect: Emits an X-shaped laser on hit, which deals {[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]} damage to enemies and applies 1 stack of radiation (max {[max_radiation_stacks]} stacks). Radiation causes enemies to receive {[radiation_pct]} more damage from all sources per stack.
X Ray.effectCn: 命中时施放一道X形激光，激光将对敌人造成{[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]}伤害，并且施加1层核辐射（最高{[max_radiation_stacks]}层）。每层核辐射使敌人额外承受{[radiation_pct]}的所有来源伤害。

Laser Cutter.name: Laser Cutter
Laser Cutter.effect: Constantly emits a laser in front of it, which deals {[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]} per second.
Laser Cutter.effectCn: 持续朝正前方发射激光，每秒造成{[min_laser_damage]}-{[max_laser_damage]}伤害。

Elemental.name: Elemental
Elemental.effect: Applies a random status effect (burn, slow, or freeze) to nearby enemies on hit.
Elemental.effectCn: 命中时对附近敌人施加1种随机状态效果（燃烧、减速或冰冻）。
